title: Scout Charisa: Kromzek Captain
summary: Help Scout Charisa confront a Kromzek captain and seven warriors.
overview: Help Scout Charisa confront a Kromzek captain and seven warriors.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Prepare control for the eight-giant group and complete the return before the scout's cleanup timer.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The initial scout-supplies turn-in loads the encounter once for that scout spawn.
A captain and seven warriors appear together at the giants' camp.
Return the recovered quest disk to the scout to advance the reward exchange.
Twenty minutes after activation, or when the scout dies, the encounter unloads and remaining giants are removed.

notes: Approval E408. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
